title: Canto X Part 2, plus various improvements

texts: Added data for Haute Couture:: Alteration Shop and the new encounters for part 2. Some enemies are still missing their portraits and will be added later.

For Alternative Options in Builds and MD Plans, the tooltip now shows the options on hover. When clicking the button, the modal now allows you to select alternative options. This will replace the corresponding Identities/E.G.O on the Build/MD Plan and updates the team code and other summary details.
Added support for Alternative Names when searching for Facades in Company.
Added sanity details to identity details in the Community Rankings page.
Removed the clash value for unclashable skills. Unbrilliant Glory is exempted from this because it becomes clashable.
Added a suggested tags section to the request tab in the Creator Directory.
Added Animation as a tag option in the Creator Directory.
